Note: Percentages are based on the number of subjects from Safety Analysis Set in each treatment group.
[2] Treatment-emergent adverse event (TEAE) is defined as any adverse event that onset, or worsens in severity on or after the date of first chemotherapy.
[3] AEs with causality of “Certainly related” , “Probably related”  and “Possibly related”are categorized to “Related”.
[4] All AEs grade will be assessed with the Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) version 4.03.
